title: Prawn and herb bulgur
summary: Prawn and herb bulgur is a middle eastern dinner built around raw king prawns and bulgur wheat, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Prawn and herb bulgur. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add raw king prawns and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and bulgur wheat.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until fresh flat-leaf parsley is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Prawn and herb bulgur before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Prawn and herb bulgur.  Serve with the bulgur, simmered in salted water until tender.
